questions.q:
Which of the following values, if any, is the $y$-value of the solution set to the system of equations below?
$$2x - y = 7$$
$$-4x + 2y = 2$$
options: There is no such value for $y$.
questions.explain: If we multiply the first equation by -2, we get $-4x + 2y = -14$. The second equation states $-4x + 2y = 2$. Since $-14 \neq 2$, the system has no solution, so there is no such value for $y$.
